content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This stack is designed for regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable. It combines GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Unlike Gumroad or Paddle, which delay payouts or restrict access, this architecture is sovereign. You control the codebase, the data, and the payment flow. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee—no KYC, no buyer accounts required. Transactions on TRON or Solana cost under $0.10, settling in minutes. This isn’t a workaround; it’s base-layer infrastructure built to withstand financial isolation. Deploy once, own forever.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather your digital products, a domain (optional but recommended), and a NOWPayments API key. Organize your files in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. If using GitHub Pages, ensure your repository is public. For Cloudflare Workers, set up a free account. No server management required. If you’re in Pakistan, consider USDT on TRON for low-cost transactions. P2P exchanges like LocalBitcoins or Binance P2P can convert PKR to USDT. Test your payment flow with a small transaction before going live. The Complete Builder Kit provides all templates and blueprints if you prefer a guided setup.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by integrating NOWPayments into your stack. Create a payment link or embed a widget on your GitHub Pages site. Configure webhooks to trigger product delivery via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. For file delivery, use signed URLs from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to prevent unauthorized access. Test the pipeline with a mock purchase. Ensure the webhook fires instantly upon payment confirmation. NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee is deducted automatically, and the remaining balance is sent to your wallet. This pipeline is stateless—no database required for small catalogs. For larger stores, use Supabase or Google Sheets to track orders.
NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee—no KYC required.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Share the live link with your audience. When a customer purchases, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and triggers the webhook. The product is delivered instantly via the signed URL. Monitor your wallet for incoming payments. For USDT on TRON, confirmations take 15-30 seconds. Solana is even faster. If using P2P exchanges in Pakistan, ensure your USDT wallet is funded to cover refunds or chargebacks. Your first transaction proves the infrastructure works. Document the process for repeat deployments.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once live, scale by adding more products or expanding to new markets. Use the Complete Builder Kit’s scaling playbook to optimize performance. Automate order tracking with Supabase or Google Sheets. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email delivery if selling courses or memberships. For high-volume stores, upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack for Cloudflare Workers and Supabase integration. Leverage NOWPayments’ multi-coin support to accept payments in BTC, ETH, or stablecoins. Your infrastructure is now a revenue engine—not a liability. Own it, scale it, and never depend on platforms again.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To set up a NOWPayments digital store in Pakistan, deploy GitHub Pages for hosting, integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions, and use Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Deliver products via signed URLs from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test the pipeline with a mock purchase. Go live by sharing your store link. Monitor transactions in your wallet. Scale by adding products or upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack.
USDT on TRON costs under $0.10 per transaction, ideal for Pakistan-based creators.

The complete payment pipeline — from buyer checkout to local currency in your account — involves three components: NOWPayments for on-chain verification, your sovereign stack backend for order processing and delivery, and a P2P exchange for conversion to local currency. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the first two components under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete process including P2P conversion guidance for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. Both available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Gather digital products and organize them in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 2. Obtain a NOWPayments API key and configure webhooks. 3. Set up GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. 4. Write backend logic in Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. 5. Test the payment and delivery pipeline with a mock transaction. 6. Deploy your store and share the live link. 7. Monitor wallet for incoming payments. 8. Document the process for future deployments.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m in Pakistan?
Yes. This stack is designed for regions like Pakistan where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. Use USDT on TRON or Solana for low-cost transactions. P2P exchanges can convert PKR to USDT.
What does NOWPayments cost?
NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee per transaction. No monthly fees, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. Transactions on TRON or Solana cost under $0.10.
Do I need to manage servers?
No. This stack uses serverless infrastructure like Cloudflare Workers and GitHub Pages. You focus on your products, not server maintenance.
How fast are payments confirmed?
USDT on TRON confirms in 15-30 seconds. Solana is even faster. NOWPayments’ webhook triggers instantly upon confirmation, delivering your product automatically.
Can I scale this infrastructure?
Yes. Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack and upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack as your store grows. The Complete Builder Kit includes scaling playbooks and templates.
